coverage_note: These ten records capture current deviations and acceptance gaps evidenced in the PE progress tracker. They are not an exhaustive audit of the full repository history or every checklist item; PE-0012 remains open until that reconciliation is complete.

records.summary: Exact locked dependency installation has not been verified locally or in both hosted CI operating systems.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; PE-0010 remains PARTIAL until a clean locked install passes on Ubuntu and Windows.
records.rollback: Keep research and release gates YELLOW; revert only the reproducibility workflow change if it makes the existing clean-install CI less reliable.

records.summary: The checklist names forward_edge.pipeline.run_session, but that module and function are absent; historical replay remains in paper.intraday_runner.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; fixture parity and the requested delegation contract are not proven.
records.rollback: Keep existing replay explicitly RESEARCH_REPLAY and refuse any promotion claim until the canonical runner has a golden trace-equivalence test.

records.summary: Durable journaling behavior was implemented inside session_runner.py because the checklist-named forward_edge.durable.py module is absent.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; fault injection at all lifecycle boundaries and one atomic journal/outbox/accounting transaction remain unproven.
records.rollback: If replay determinism or recovery fails, stop new paper intents and rebuild views from the append-only runner audit stream; do not silently switch journal implementations.

records.summary: Paper OMS and gross accounting are rebuilt as projections from durable receipts instead of being transactionally committed with the execution outbox.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; current output is gross replay accounting and is not net-P&L or promotion evidence.
records.rollback: On projection mismatch, fail closed, preserve immutable intents and receipts, stop new executions, and rebuild the projection before resuming.

records.summary: Clock injection exists in adapters and the runner, but the production supervisor does not pass one provider across the complete lifecycle.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; end-to-end receipt, decision, and execution clock provenance remains incomplete.
records.rollback: Reject sessions with missing or inconsistent clocks; retain the last known event hashes and do not synthesize timestamps.

records.summary: Session recovery rebuilds OMS and accounting state, but does not restore risk verdict state as one atomic projection.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; identical risk, position, and cash reconstruction after restart is not established.
records.rollback: Keep UNKNOWN outbox items unresolved and block new orders until durable risk and accounting state can be reconciled.

records.summary: Checkpoint ledger hashes cover a deterministic projection but are not atomically committed with runner and outbox records.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; checkpoint verification is not evidence of atomic ledger binding or daily replay verification.
records.rollback: Mark an unbound or mismatched checkpoint INCOMPLETE, preserve the audit log, and refuse a verified close.

records.summary: Normalized quotes retain available depth fields, but the legacy forward event path does not yet use those fields as a universal execution gate.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; quote normalization does not establish executable liquidity coverage.
records.rollback: Classify LTP-only and incomplete-depth observations as non-executable and reject fills that lack two-sided displayed liquidity.

records.summary: The executable_quote predicate is tested, but not every strategy and promotion entry point calls it before execution.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; helper correctness does not prove universal execution-path enforcement.
records.rollback: Disable the affected adapter and refuse execution until it passes the shared executable-quote gate.

records.summary: New forward fills carry source event hashes, while legacy intraday trades are not yet represented in the same forward session evidence package.
records.effect_on_evidence_status: NO_UPGRADE; cross-engine source-to-fill lineage is not system-wide.
records.rollback: Keep legacy trades outside the forward-confirmatory cohort and quarantine records with missing raw source hashes.
